title: Cell-based Calcium Assay for Medium to High Throughput Screening of TRP Channel Functions using FlexStation 3
protocol: Grow HEK293 cells for one to two days in DMEM containing 4.5 mg/ml glucose supplemented with fetal bovine serum, penicillin, and streptomycin.
Coat 96-well plates by pipetting 50 μl poly-L-ornithine at 20 μg/ml into each well and incubating for at least 15 min at 37°C.
Rinse each well once with DPBS without Mg²⁺ and Ca²⁺.
Dilute 0.2 μg cDNA in 25 μl OPTI-MEM for each well to be transfected.
Dilute 0.4 μl Lipofectamine 2000 in 25 μl OPTI-MEM for each well to be transfected.
Briefly vortex the diluted cDNA and Lipofectamine 2000 together.
Let the vortexed mixture sit at room temperature for about 5 min.
Transfer an equal volume of diluted Lipofectamine 2000 to the tube containing diluted cDNA.
Vortex the mixture and let it sit at room temperature for 15 min to 2 hrs.
Transfer a 49 μl/well mixture of cDNA/Lipofectamine 2000 to poly-L-ornithine coated plates.
Trypsinize HEK293 cells.
Count cell density using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 1000 x RPM for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in DMEM culture medium supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated fetal bovine serum, without antibiotics, to achieve a concentration of ~1,250,000-1,500,000 cells/ml.
Dispense 98 μl of cell suspension into each well containing the cDNA-Lipofectamine mixture.
Let the plate sit in the hood for at least 30 min.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 20-44 hrs.
Maintain the inducible HEK293-hTRPA1 cell line in the same medium as wild-type HEK293 cells but supplemented with blasticidin and hygromycin B.
Trypsinize cells when density reaches about 90%.
Count cell density and centrifuge at 1000 x RPM for 5 min.
Resuspend cells at a density of ~1,000,000 cells/ml in culture medium supplemented with doxycycline.
Dispense the cell suspension to poly-L-ornithine coated plates using a multichannel pipette or MicroFill.
Incubate plate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for 16 - 24 hr.
Dissolve 1 mg Fluo-4 AM in 912 μl anhydrous DMSO to make a stock solution of 1 mM.
Store the Fluo-4 AM stock solution at -20°C for up to one month.
Mix 10 μl 1 mM Fluo-4 AM with 10 μl Pluronic F-127 and transfer to 5 ml Fluo-4 assay buffer supplemented with 0.1% Bovine serum albumin.
Wash cells grown in 96-well plates twice with HBSS at 80 μl/well using a microplate washer.
Add the Fluo-4 AM loading solution at 50 μl/well using a multichannel pipette or MicroFill and incubate the plate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Wash cells three times with the Fluo-4 assay buffer using the ELx405TM microplate washer.
Leave 80 μl of the Fluo-4 assay buffer in each well after the last wash.
Prepare a series of 3x dilutions of agonists or antagonists at 3x the desired final concentrations in the Fluo-4 assay buffer during the cell loading period.
Pipette 250-300 μl of diluted compound solutions to a 96-well compound plate.
Turn on the system (FlexStation 3, computer, and the SoftMax Pro 5.2 software).
Save the experiment with a new file name.
Choose FLEX mode at the set-up.
Enter the values for Protocol #1.
Enter the values for Protocol #2.
Place a new tip box to the appropriate tray in FlexStation 3.
Place a compound plate to the appropriate tray in FlexStation 3.
Place a reading plate to the appropriate tray in FlexStation 3.
Click "read" button.
The FlexStation 3 will read one column at a time.
Add compounds at preprogrammed time points during reading.
Continue reading until all columns are read.
Load HEK293-hTRPA1 cells with Fluo-4 AM.
Place the loaded cells in 80 μl of assay buffer.
Read fluorescence using FlexStation 3.
Record baseline fluorescence for 30 s.
Add 40 μl of serial dilution of TRPA1 agonist FFA at 3x desired final concentration to the cells through a multi-channel pipetter.
Monitor fluorescence changes for an additional 180 s.
Perform an experiment using protocol #2 step 2 to test compound A as a TRPA1 antagonist.
Prepare a series of dilutions of the antagonist.
Add 40 μl of antagonist at 3x desired final concentrations at 30 seconds.
Add FFA 180 seconds later with 60 μl at 300 μM for a final concentration of 100 μM.
